1651-2499-2638-6756-8344.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2499-2638-6756-8344.notablePrerequisites:
Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-2499-2638-6756-8344.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Yarok, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

2034-3558-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crookshank Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
2034-3558-5006-8170.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crookshank Kobolds spell. Then, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, adding {C}{C}
Repeat.

3755-3995-7008.easyPrerequisites: Horseshoe Crab doesn't have summoning sickness.
3755-3995-7008.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

560-1563-2457-8201.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

803-4881-6909-7884.manaNeeded: {1}{W}{U} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
803-4881-6909-7884.description:
Cast Sygg's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

396-728-3249-5268--52.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
396-728-3249-5268--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

628-821-2018.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability
Repeat

240-3899-4068-5470.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
240-3899-4068-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

1170-2981-3836-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2981-3836-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Urza.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn
Repeat.

729-5231-5917.description:
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Great Oak Guardian that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
When the Great Oak Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Great Oak Guardian, adding at least one mana.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

969-2411-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-2411-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Lathril, triggering Breath of Fury and Lathril.
Resolve the Lathril trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

4200-5998-6626-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1251-1409-3099-4289.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

803-1524-5256-5659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ilharg.
When Ilharg dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Ilharg's power, which will cause you to mill Ilharg.
As Ilharg is a Lhurgoyf due to Arcane Adaptation, Disa's first ability triggers, returning Ilharg from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

6797-7084-7422.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

423-1257-1437-3478--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1257-1437-3478--85.description:
Cast Walking Atlas by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Walking Atlas spell three times.
Resolve the first Walking Atlas copy.
Activate the Walking Atlas token by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-6132-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Repeat from step 3.

339-677-1115-2511.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4050-5544-6193-6822.description:
Cast Forsaken Miner by paying {B}.
When Forsaken Miner enters, Soul of the Harvest triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
Resolve the Soul of the Harvest trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, targeting a creature an opponent controls.
Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Lyla triggers.

602-3591-4067-6282.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card.
Necropotence and Feast of Sanity trigger.
Resolve the Feast of Sanity trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Necropotence trigger, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1786-3591-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have a card in hand.
392-1786-3591-6282.description:
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
Resolve all Harnfel abilities.

856-4050-4321-6351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4050-4321-6351.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

5940-6452.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant or sorcery card in hand with enough mana to cast it.
You have enough mana to cast Return the Favor
5940-6452.description:
Cast the additional instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
If Adaptive Training Post had two charge counters on it, it triggers, putting a charge counter on it.
Holding priority, activate Adaptive Training Post by removing three charge counters from it, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn.
Cast Return the Favor by paying its mana cost, targeting the spell cast in step 1.
Adaptive Training Post triggers, copying Return the Favor, with the copy targeting the original Return the Favor.
Resolve the copy of Return the Favor, copying the original Return the Favor, with the copy targeting the original Return the Favor.
Repeat step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more loyalty counters on it

598-4659-6429.description:
Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Razorlash Transmogrant from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Razorlash Transmogrant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

372-3563-4863.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Revolutionist exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate.
372-3563-4863.description:
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Revolutionist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Revolutionist trigger.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Flicker of Fate from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Revolutionist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

930-2594-3781-5231.description:
Activate Winding Canyons' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, allowing you to cast creature spells as though they have flash this turn.
Cast Universal Automaton from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Universal Automaton, adding {1}.
When Universal Automaton dies, Zask triggers.
Holding priority, cast Universal Automaton from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Resolve the Zask trigger, causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat from step 3.

224-4948-5196.notablePrerequisites:
At least one basic land in hand.
Estrid's Invocation is a copy of Retreat to Coralhelm.
Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
224-4948-5196.description:
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's first ability, putting a basic land from your hand onto the battlefield.
The Retreat to Coralhelms trigger.
In response, activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Let the first Retreat to Coralhelm trigger resolve, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's last ability, returning any basic land you control from the battlefield to your hand.
Let the second Retreat trigger resolve, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Repeat.

215-1283-2092-4617.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
215-1283-2092-4617.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin three times by paying {3}, adding {8}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}, returning Soulbright Flamekin to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

1680-3459-4461-4508.notablePrerequisites:
Battered Golem does not have summoning sickness.
Runed Stalactite attached to Battered Golem.
1680-3459-4461-4508.description:
Activate Battered Golem by paying {R} and tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping itself.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1368-1396-4682.notablePrerequisites:
A player has at least four cards in hand.
There are at least three additional cards in your graveyard.
At least one opponent is unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
1368-1396-4682.description:
Cast Whispering Madness from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{U}{B} and exiling three cards from your graveyard, causing each player to discard at least four cards and draw at least four cards.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each card drawn by your opponents, creating that many Treasure tokens.
Activate four of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{B}.
Repeat.

489-2604-4489.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that has Morph or Megamorph.
489-2604-4489.description:
Cast the creature using its morph or megamorph cost by paying {0}, putting it face-down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
Activate Primordial Mist by exiling the face down creature face up, allowing you to cast it this turn.
Repeat.

2034-3169-4404-4598-5261.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Essence Flux without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Corridor Monitor.
Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Genesis Chamber.
Resolve the Corridor Monitor, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
